placement_plan.common_transform: For every shared-power item and M1 source-mapped item apply the SAME board-origin translation T=(target_x-99.1235,target_y-79.8475), then model-specific rigid pad-origin/rotation correction. Do not assign power a separate downshift.
placement_plan.M2: Copy only full current FOC module below M1 with dx=0,dy=actual M1 full envelope height+8mm. Current module needs approximately78.5mm pitch because TP/new peripherals; nominal55mm+margin only if true full-module clearance verified.
placement_plan.shared_power: Exactly one input/protection/DCbus/buck/LDO/reference set, never duplicate for M2.
placement_plan.control: GD32/HSLink/display do not inherit STM32 coordinates. Repack these groups into free left/lower regions around M2, preserving internal clusters; eliminate global208 downshift and do not treat283mm workspace as board outline.
placement_plan.envelope: Source power+M1 uses original100x55mm relationships; two-module work envelope roughly100x(55+actual_pitch)mm before new control/HSLink clearance. Not a board size commitment.

source_no_copy: reference R27 local5V bridge when absent current
reference R54/DAC selection branch when absent current
